task_title: Add cast VFX for fireball/pulse-shield/heal + HUD slot flash

plan_review.notes: 1 blocking + 4 non-blocking. #1 (spellCast depth 17 might be under actors): empirically FALSE for this codebase — actor sprites use default Phaser depth 0 (no setDepth in PhaserBridge), so 17 renders above actors and hit sparks (12), below combatText (20). Documented in render-depths.ts comment. #2/#3 (intensity semantics + fireball ring not tied to radius): FIXED. Added optional radiusFt to VfxEvent; fireballBlast + pulseShieldWave now pass radiusFt for ring size; fireball intensity remains hit count but drives spark count only. #4 (before/after applyDamage ordering doesn't control overlap — depth does): acknowledged, no code change needed (depth handles it). #5 (HUD yellow flash collides with yellow cooldown bar): FIXED. Changed flash to cool cyan/white palette (fill 0xf0f9ff, border 0x22d3ee) with dark cyan label, distinct from warm-yellow cooldown ring 0xfbbf24.
